# NVO987.eu – Sites UNESCO en France

> Publication culturelle et documentaire en ligne consacrée aux sites du patrimoine mondial de l'UNESCO situés en France.

## Publisher

NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

https://nvo987.fr/

## Main publication

https://unesco-fr.nvo987.eu/

## Description

NVO987.eu is an independent cultural and documentary online publication for
consulting, searching and filtering information about UNESCO World Heritage
sites located in France.

The publication is regularly updated.

## Data

The site's structured data are derived from Wikidata.

Wikidata:
https://www.wikidata.org/

Data licence:
CC0 1.0 Universal

https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

## Privacy

The site is designed without user accounts, advertising profiling,
behavioural analytics or unnecessary personal-data collection.

Search is performed locally in the user's browser.

## Legal

The publication is independent and is not affiliated with UNESCO or any
official UNESCO institution.

Official legal information:

https://nvo987.fr/mentions-legales.html
